simple.meaning: סָמַן (çâman) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to designate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 28:25. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָמַן (H5567) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סָמַן (çâman) / H5567 is traced through Isaiah 28:25 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

definitions.full: H5567. saman סמן verb whence Niph`al Participle נִסְמָן Isa 28:25 (si vera lectio) barley in an appointed place , or a determined portion (compare Ges Hi De and others), but ׳נ lacking in ᵐ5 and plausibly taken as dittograph for כֻּסֶּמֶת by We Prol. 417 ; Geschichte. Israel i. 409 Che Comm. and Hpt. Du; compare Brd Gu Kau .
